title: Dependency Signal Arbiter: Automated Readiness Scoring and Escalation Flow
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Problem: Cross-team roadmap items frequently surface late blockers (security sign-offs, infra capacity, design polish) that are discovered ad-hoc during sprints. Current tracking is distributed across docs, Slack threads, and ad-hoc Linear tickets which makes it hard to quantify readiness and route escalations.

Goal: Build a lightweight orchestration layer (Dependency Signal Arbiter) that synthesizes readiness signals across Eng, Design, Security, and Infra into a single readiness score per roadmap dependency, and triggers automated, policy-driven escalations when a dependency falls below thresholds. The Arbiter should be visible in the roadmap UI, produce telemetry for PM/Eng leads, and be pluggable so teams can customize signals and escalation policies.

Scope (MVP v1):
- Define an initial set of signals: owner confirmation, design artifact status, infra provisioning ETA, security review status, open-blocker count, and automated test coverage flag.
- Implement a scoring function (0-100) with configurable weights per-signal via a simple admin config.
- Wire a small data pipeline that pulls signal sources: Linear custom fields, Design Figma status, GitHub/MR labels, and Security OK-status from the security tracker.
- Create a Roadmap Dependency card with score, signal breakdown, and last-updated timestamp.
- Implement automatic escalation actions: create an incident-style Linear blocker (if not present), send targeted Slack notification to on-call/owners, and add to the weekly dependency report.
- Telemetry: time-to-resolution for escalations, percent of dependencies below threshold, and trend charts for score changes.

Out of scope for v1: ML-based signal inference, automatic mitigation (auto-fallback routes), and multi-tenant RBAC for the admin UI.

Success metrics:
- 95% of new roadmap dependencies have a score within 72 hours of initial parent issue creation.
- 90% of low-score (<=40) dependencies generate an automated escalation within 15 minutes of the score being computed.
- PM/Eng leads report a reduction in 'surprise' late blockers in retrospective surveys by 30% after two cycles.
acceptance_criteria: Dependency card appears on roadmap entries and shows a computed readiness score with signal breakdown
Scoring pipeline ingests signals from Linear custom fields, Figma status, GitHub labels, and Security tracker for >90% of new dependencies
Configurable weight table available to PMs (UI + API) and persisted in console-2026.04 release config
Automated escalation creates a Linear blocker and posts a Slack message with owner mention within 15 minutes of low-score detection
Telemetry dashboards show time-to-resolution and score trends for the last 12 weeks
